name: East Bay Regional Park District Youth and Student Jobs
city: Oakland, CA and parks across Alameda and Contra Costa counties
what_you_do: You can get seasonal paid student jobs such as recreation leader, lifeguard, gate attendant, student laborer and interpretive student aide. The jobs include pathways from high school to college.
who_can_apply: Gate Attendant (high school pathway): at least 16 and completed 10th grade. Other jobs have their own rules; check each posting.
pay_detail: Pay is not posted on the youth pages. See each job posting.
deadline_text: No jobs were posted on governmentjobs.com on Oct 7, 2026. Watch ebparks.org/jobs/youth and governmentjobs.com/careers/ebparks.
notes: The 16 minimum is from the Gate Attendant page; other roles (for example lifeguard) may differ. The park district says it hires hundreds of seasonal students each year.
